tool_input.description: Reproduce both bugs against original code from HEAD

result:
All green. `--dry-run` deletes nothing and targets only the oldest archives, `--name` filtering, `--help`, unknown-option and bad-value exits all behave as before.

**What I did:**

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation arithmetic: the early exit is now `total -le keep` (nothing to delete at exactly N), and `surplus` is `head -n "$((total - keep))"` so the *oldest* archives past the newest N get removed, not the newest. Also replaced its duplicated parser/`resolve_dir` block with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed sidecar parsing: the line is now split with a bash regex (`^([^[:space:]]+)[[:space:]]+(.+)$`) so a file name containing spaces is taken whole instead of being truncated by `awk '{print $2}'` (which made every spaced name look like a missing archive). Also quoted the digest comparison. Replaced its duplicated parser/`resolve_dir` block with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` helper, sourced by both scripts (scripts still define `usage`/`parse_local_option` first, all flags unchanged). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a test that `--keep 3` deletes nothing when exactly 3 archives exist and the newest survives (plus a 4-archives case deleting only the oldest), and a test that verify reports `ok`/rc=0 for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`. Both new tests reproduce the reported bugs on the original code (verified against HEAD); `bash tests/run_tests.sh` now passes all 9 checks.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
